definition: Unification of mind governed by the wishless side of the emptiness / signless / wishless family.
notes: Keep this compound tied to appaṇihita as wishless rather than flattening it into relaxed passivity or generic calm.
version_notes: Revised 2026-11-08 by explicit editorial decision to follow Dhammarato's spoken usage in the 2014–2026 talk transcripts: follows the samādhi headword.
